# Incomplete browser fragment bundles use the operational recovery exclusion

The browser-fragment-assembly-incomplete record type now uses the existing operational recovery classification. A bounded official cleanup excluded the two saved originals from normal search and pending learning while preserving exact ID access and immutable bytes. This is a specific case of the [existing recovery retrieval policy](6707a842eadd834d31530f6de6e48cb3220fbcb55afedd405e6045c0f0f5f7ed.md). Thirteen cleanup tests and an independent scoped diff check passed; the implementation remains locally uncommitted.

Scope: Knowledge retrieval cleanup.
